svg.title: AI-native enterprise memory architecture
svg.desc: Three-layer model: signals ingested from organizational sources, processed through memory layers (episodic, semantic, procedural), and surfaced as context-aware intelligence to knowledge workers.

g.text: Every interaction, decision, and document becomes a memory candidate

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What signals does enterprise memory ingest from meetings?')
sendPrompt('How are emails and messages captured?')
sendPrompt('How are documents and wikis ingested?')
sendPrompt('What code and ticket signals matter for enterprise memory?')
sendPrompt('How are decisions and outcomes tracked?')
sendPrompt('What does customer signal mean in enterprise memory?')
sendPrompt('What is episodic memory in enterprise AI? Give examples.')
sendPrompt('What is semantic memory in enterprise AI? Give examples.')
sendPrompt('What is procedural memory in enterprise AI? Give examples.')

g.text: Memory retrieved and composed at the moment of need
